subject.casting: resolved by the avatar kit — see Avatars/Sol/AVATAR.md

scene.look: Casual handheld selfie video, one continuous take. He sits in his parked car in late-afternoon sun coming through the side window. Real skin texture, natural uneven daylight, no beauty filter. Full-bleed, fills the frame edge to edge, no border, no mockup.
scene.camera: He holds the phone himself so the frame bobs and drifts; auto-exposure hunts as the light shifts. Casual, mid-conversation energy. One continuous unbroken take.
scene.voice: Natural Southern-Californian accent, easy and unhurried; open throat, slightly clipped consonants.

beats.action: He looks into the lens with an easy half-smile, small laugh at the end.
beats.line: Yeah man, honestly this one's the real deal. I wasn't expecting that.

audio.direction: Audio: his voice close on the phone microphone inside the car, cabin room tone under it, muffled traffic outside. No instruments, no melody, no song, no soundtrack.

proof._why: No props in hand; the whole clip is 5s (proof-length) already.
